Create a warm festive display with this 38cm Gold Elegance Twist standing baby reindeer from Samuel Alexander. Its elegant gold metal frame is wrapped with delicate pin wire lighting and 30 warm white LEDs, making it a charming addition to traditional or contemporary Christmas décor.
